es: Reescribir un titular y un párrafo con lenguaje neutro, verbos de reporte neutros y cada dato atribuido a su fuente.

teaching.en: Ana will rewrite the headline in neutral wording.
teaching.es: Ana reescribirá el titular con una redacción neutra.
teaching.explanationEs: Rewrite: escribir de nuevo. Wording: las palabras concretas que eliges.
teaching.audioText: Ana will rewrite the headline in neutral wording.

teaching.en: Greedy bus company hits commuters with shocking fare rise.
teaching.es: La codiciosa empresa de autobuses golpea a los viajeros con una escandalosa subida de tarifas.
teaching.explanationEs: Titular sesgado: greedy, hits y shocking son palabras cargadas. Commuters son los viajeros habituales.
teaching.audioText: Greedy bus company hits commuters with shocking fare rise.

teaching.en: The bus company announces a fare rise of ten per cent.
teaching.es: La empresa de autobuses anuncia una subida de tarifas del diez por ciento.
teaching.explanationEs: Versión neutral: verbo informativo y una cifra en lugar de un adjetivo.
segments: The bus company announces a fare
teaching.audioText: The bus company announces a fare rise of ten per cent.

teaching.en: The company spokesperson says that costs have risen.
teaching.es: El portavoz de la empresa dice que los costes han subido.
teaching.explanationEs: Se atribuye el dato a su fuente: a spokesperson says that…
teaching.audioText: The company spokesperson says that costs have risen.

teaching.en: We attribute the number to the council.
teaching.explanationEs: Attribute to: decir de quién viene cada dato.
teaching.audioText: We attribute the number to the council.

teaching.en: The new parking fee is two dollars an hour.
teaching.es: El nuevo precio del aparcamiento es de dos dólares por hora.
teaching.explanationEs: Fee: precio de un servicio. Con cifra concreta no hace falta un adjetivo.
teaching.audioText: The new parking fee is two dollars an hour.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase atribuye el dato a una fuente?

choices.text: 200 students joined the club, everyone knows.
The school was surprised that 200 students joined.
According to the school, 200 students joined the club.

feedback.es: According to + fuente dice de quién viene el dato. Las otras dos no citan fuente o añaden emoción.

prompt.es: Escribe la noticia neutral: titular, cifras y dos fuentes atribuidas.

answer.text: City council raises parking fee to two dollars an hour. From the first of March, the fee will rise from one dollar to two dollars an hour. A council spokesperson says that maintenance costs have risen. According to a residents' association, the new fee is too high for small shops. The association also says that some customers may stop coming. The council and the association give different reasons, and the effect on shop sales has not been confirmed.
accepted: City council raises parking fee to two dollars an hour. From the first of March, the fee will rise from one dollar to two dollars an hour. A council spokesperson says that maintenance costs have risen. According to a residents' association, the new fee is too high for small shops. The association also says that some customers may stop coming. The council and the association give different reasons, and the effect on shop sales has not been confirmed.

Parking fee to rise to two dollars an hour. The fee is now one dollar an hour. The council will raise the fee from one dollar to two dollars an hour on the first of March. A council spokesperson states that maintenance costs have risen. A residents' association says that the new fee is too high for small shops. According to the association, some customers may stop coming. The council has not commented on the effect on sales.

feedback.es: La versión neutral cambia las palabras cargadas por hechos y cifras, y atribuye cada dato a su fuente con verbos neutros.

origin.text: Noticia sesgada: «El codicioso ayuntamiento golpea a los vecinos con una escandalosa subida del parking.» Datos: desde el 1 de marzo, la tasa sube de 1 a 2 dólares por hora. Portavoz del ayuntamiento: los costes de mantenimiento han subido. Asociación de vecinos: la tasa es demasiado alta para los comercios pequeños. Reescríbela en unas 90 palabras.

feedback.es: «Museum extends opening hours on Sundays» informa del cambio con un verbo neutro. «Gives in» y «terrible pressure» añaden juicio.
